question: Who won the bronze medal in womens boxing in Tokyo Olympics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lovina Borgohain.**__​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Lovlina Borgohain – Tokyo Olympics 2020 Women's Boxing (Welterweight)**

__
 
• **Event:**

 
 
• Women's Welterweight Boxing (64-69 kg)
 
 
 
• **Medal:**
 
 
• Bronze Medal
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain** secured the bronze after reaching the semi-finals. As per **Olympic boxing rules**, both losing semi-finalists are awarded bronze medals.
 
 
 
• **Journey to the Medal:**
 
 
• Lovlina won her quarter-final match against Nien-Chin Chen of Chinese Taipei with a convincing 4-1 victory, ensuring her a place in the semi-finals and a guaranteed medal.
 
• In the semi-finals, she faced the top-seeded Turkish boxer** Busenaz Sürmeneli**, a tough opponent, and despite her efforts, she lost the bout 0-5, securing the bronze
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mirabai Chanu:**

 
 
• Won the silver medal in weightlifting (49 kg category) at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.
 
• She is the second Indian weightlifter to win an Olympic medal after** Karnam Malleswari.**
 
 
 
• **MC Mary Kom:**
 
 
• A legendary boxer with six World Championships and a bronze medal at the 2012 London Olympics.
 
• Known as the "Magnificent Mary," she is a pioneering figure in Indian women’s boxing.
 
 
 
• **Aditi Ashok:**
 
 
• A professional golfer who finished 4th at the Tokyo Olympics 2020, narrowly missing a medal.
 
• She is one of the leading figures in Indian golf, having competed in both the Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
